subject: Kobold Warrior
picture: All-ages fantasy coloring book page, portrait. Outline art only. A small scaly kobold warrior in a tight stone corridor cackles beside an open pit trap. No rope. No tripwire. No string. The trap is a rectangular pit in the floor with a tilting stone lid and simple spikes drawn as large triangles inside the pit, white interiors to color, not black. Kobold, not a goblin: short snout, cranial ridges or small horns, long tail, scaly hide in large plates, spear and slatted shield. Stone ceiling, large block walls, large floor slabs, one wall torch as an empty colorable shape, closed far door. Bold even line weight matching I-08. No black fills, no blank holes, no page frame.

line_rules.ink: bold even outlines only on white
